frequency_question: How often do states successfully sign a successor water treaty within the final two years before expiration when advance bureaucratic and technical signalling is observed?
membership_rule: Includes formal transboundary river water treaties up for renewal that had established joint commissions and technical committees functioning prior to expiration; excludes unilateral abrogations or cases with no prior legal framework.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and continuous renegotiation mechanisms
Canada-US Columbia River Treaty regime extensions and reviews
South Africa-Lesotho Highlands Water Project protocols
Israel-Jordan Peace Treaty water annex implementation
Senegal River Basin Development Organisation convention renewals

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 8 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.3x)
coverage_note: 6 named major historical cases; estimated universe of comparable structured bilateral treaty renewals is ~8.
known_gaps: Excludes minor municipal or sub-national river pacts where publicity is low.
skeleton: Global transboundary water agreements requiring renewal periods categorized by whether joint technical committees met in the final 24 months
multiplier: 6 hits out of 8 comparable major foundational water treaty renewal cycles where technical precursors were visible
validity_reason: International water law norms and institutional frameworks for basin management change slowly over decades.
